import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load and aggregate monthly revenue across regions.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
monthly = df.groupby('month', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum().sort_values('month')
monthly['revenue_2mo_ma'] = monthly['revenue'].rolling(window=2, min_periods=2).mean()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.plot(monthly['month'], monthly['revenue_2mo_ma'], marker='o', label='2-month moving average')
ax.set_title('2-Month Moving Average of Total Monthly Revenue')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
